items.title: 118th Street Study Public Meeting Presentation
items.description: Presents three improvement alternatives for 118th Street between Dennis Chavez Boulevard and Amole Mesa Avenue, with existing conditions, crash data, bicycle and pedestrian facilities, right-of-way constraints, estimated construction costs, and bilingual public-meeting material.
items.provenance_status: official City project page and byte-identical source file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 27-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; extracted text and the rendered cover were reviewed.
The City project page remains linked as the source of truth for current status.

items.title: Amole Mesa Avenue and Messina Drive Traffic Calming Study Public Meeting Presentation
items.description: Documents 2023 traffic and crash conditions on Amole Mesa Avenue and Messina Drive, evaluates the corridors against Neighborhood Traffic Management Program thresholds, and illustrates striping, traffic-circle, curb-extension, and pedestrian-refuge alternatives considered for speed management.
items.provenance_status: official City project page and byte-identical source file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 25-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; extracted text and the rendered cover were reviewed.
The City project page remains linked as the source of truth; the expired 2023 comment contact is not republished.
